findings.title: Test the new exit-code contract, not just error messages
findings.body: The disabled-feature test checks only error text, and the incompatible-version tests never assert the exit status. This PR changes the recreate status from 4 to 3 and assigns 4 to feature-disabled failures, but neither value is verified. The tool explicitly directs automation to rely on exit codes rather than messages, so returning the wrong status—or success—would pass these tests while misleading upgrade scripts. Assert exit code 4 for both disabled metadata and check commands, 3 for incompatible versions, and 0 for a compatible check.
